standard_rate_benchmark_result: On five common High-preset conversions, staged-short is faster than wide SoX on four (48->96, 96->48, 48->32, and 88.2->44.1 kHz), remains slower on 192->48 kHz, and is faster than ARDFTSRC on all five.
standard_rate_signal_result: Five common High conversions (48->96, 96->48, 192->48, 48->32, 88.2->44.1 kHz) pass selected passband gain comparisons within 0.047 dB of ARDFTSRC and produce exact frame counts. Impulse peaks align and reversal errors are below 8e-15. Selected alias probes exceed 154.8 dB attenuation; at 192->48, two near-output-Nyquist probes are 3.3-3.6 dB weaker than SoX/ARDFTSRC. The 48->96 image probe is about -195.0 dB.
standard_rate_planner2_result: The High 48->96 DFT plan is 7.8% faster than wide SoX on the 10-trial standard matrix and matches its measured tones/images. High 96->48 and 192->48 plans restore measured alias attenuation, but remain slower than SoX. Full High tone/image matrices were rerun at this candidate hash.
